facts.fact: 52.3 per cent of people aged 10 and over in Malawi owned a mobile phone in 2021, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
55.9 per cent of people aged 10 and over in Malawi owned a mobile phone in 2022, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
56.6 per cent of people aged 10 and over in Malawi owned a mobile phone in 2023, a survey figure the country reported to the International Telecommunication Union.
57.2 per cent of people aged 10 and over in Malawi owned a mobile phone in 2024, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
